name: services/prgroups/create_descriptor
description: Create a descriptor of primary groups.
brief_description: Create a descriptor of primary groups.

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.description: Validate submitted arguments, but do not perform any persistent changes.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of the following structure:

  • descriptor_id - created descriptor ID.

    This key will be available even if you set dry_run argument to true - in this case the value is just extracted from the source of the descriptor.
errors:
• object_invalid - object is in invalid state.

    Possible reasons:

    • id_duplicated - descriptor ID is already in use;

    • parse_error - descriptor source could not be parsed; an additional key parse_messages with the list of parse error messages will be provided.
